bookings.settings.calendar.description: Durations and warnings count working days. Free days and holidays stretch a booking; they never block one.
bookings.settings.calendar.title: Working calendar
bookings.settings.errors.conflict: The settings were just saved by someone else. Reload and try again.
bookings.settings.errors.holidayDuplicat: This holiday is already on the list.
bookings.settings.errors.holidayLabel: The name can have at most 120 characters.
bookings.settings.errors.holidaysTooMany: The list can hold at most 1000 holidays.
bookings.settings.errors.noWorkingDay: At least one day of the week must stay a working day.
bookings.settings.errors.threshold: Enter a whole number of working days from 0 to 250.
bookings.settings.errors.timeZoneOffset: Choose a named zone such as Europe/Warsaw. A bare offset like GMT+3 does not know when the clock changes.
bookings.settings.errors.timeZoneRequire: Choose the time zone before saving anything else.
bookings.settings.errors.timeZoneUnknown: This time zone is not on the standard list.
bookings.settings.nav.title: Bookings
bookings.settings.policy.advisory.descri: The save goes through and the conflict is reported.
bookings.settings.policy.advisory.label: Warn
bookings.settings.policy.description: What happens when a save would book one subject twice at the same time. A clash with unavailability never blocks.
bookings.settings.policy.reject.descript: The save that would create an overlap fails.
bookings.settings.policy.reject.label: Refuse
bookings.settings.policy.title: Conflict policy
bookings.settings.threshold.description: How many working days before the expected start an unplaced booking is flagged.
bookings.settings.threshold.hint: The same number drives the bar and the "Needs attention" panel.
bookings.settings.threshold.title: Early warning
bookings.settings.timeZone.changeNote: Changing it does not move existing targets and subjects; each keeps its own zone. New ones start from the new zone.
bookings.settings.timeZone.description: The zone of the organization. It decides which day it is for everything that has no place of its own.
bookings.settings.timeZone.firstSave: Choose the time zone first. Nothing can be booked until it is saved; the other sections unlock after that.
bookings.settings.timeZone.title: Time zone
